events.evidence: The United Nations suspends humanitarian aid delivery at the U.S. military-constructed Gaza floating pier
Russian President Vladimir Putin announces that he is ready for a ceasefire if Ukraine withdraws from Russian-claimed territories
Germany vetoes a European Union sanction package that would prevent EU members from re-exporting Russian liquefied natural gas

label.note: Gaza pier aid suspension and Houthi retaliation keep risk elevated; Putin ceasefire comment is conditional and rejected.
